narr: A boundary stalled across northeast Maryland and interacted with the Chesapeake Bay breeze to result in a nearly stationary thunderstorm across Baltimore and Harford counties for much of the late afternoon and evening. Localized rainfall amounts of two to six inches were observed, with instances of flash flooding.
ev: The 12000 block of Jericho Road was closed due to water flowing across the road.
Belair Road closed due to high water. Water rescue took place near the Fallston Mall.
Belair Road at Old Joppa Road closed due to high water. North Tollgate Road also closed due to high water. Around one foot of water flowing across the roads.
Philadelphia Road closed due to flooding near Four Seasons Drive, with an ongoing swift water rescue.
Hookers Mill Road at Calvary Road closed due to at least 12 inches of water flowing across the road.
